description: This is a Perl script used for flashing firmware on D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices, specifically a Fritz!Box variant. The script performs network scanning for devices, interacts via FTP to retrieve device info, and uploads firmware files to the device using specific protocols.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods to interact with the embedded device, including environment variable retrieval and reboot commands.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints the usage information and exits.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Enters passive mode via FTP command.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the device via FTP.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables via FTP.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to the device via FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device via FTP after issuing command.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash check on the device to verify firmware integrity.
